remarks: Sixth floor fractional ownership at the Tamarack Club at Holiday Valley. Located at the main base area of Holiday Valley Resort, you will be within walking distance to the golf course and ski slopes. Ownership amenities include discounts on golf, daily list tickets, private owner locker room, private owner lounge, year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, 2 hot tubs, sauna and fitness center. Valet parking, underground parking while lodging overnight, and access to 10-11 weeks per year, plus additional time based on space.
